subject: Partner request: bulk access codes for Dev Night (500)
body:
--- Message 1/4 ---
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:34 -0700
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@devcommunity.org>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: hackclub@devcommunity.org
Subject: Request: 500 partner access codes for Dev Night (July 10)

Hi Grace / Marissa —

Thanks again for sponsoring our upcoming Dev Night on July 10. We typically offer attendees a simple way to try partner platforms after the event — would Redwood be able to provide 500 one-time access codes (or promo codes) that we can distribute to attendees?

Quick details:
- Event date: 2025-07-10, expected RSVPs ~420, with walk-ins up to ~500
- Goal: give attendees a low-friction trial to encourage follow-up signups; codes should expire 90 days after issuance
- We can ingest a CSV you provide into our registration flow; Eventbrite can accept code lists if we upload a batch.

Can you confirm:
1) Whether 500 codes are available under partner / marketing credit (no per-account billing)?
2) Suggested trial length / usage cap per code (e.g., 30/60/90 days; per-account cap)?
3) Logistics: CSV format you prefer and any token limits we should show on the landing page.

Appreciate a quick confirmation — we need the file by EOD July 3 to finalize the event materials.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Partnerships Manager — Dev Community Org

--- Message 2/4 (internal reply) ---
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 10:02:17 -0700
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Subject: Fwd: Request: 500 partner access codes for Dev Night (July 10)

Marissa / Ben / Neha — forwarding Lena's ask. TL;DR: partner needs 500 codes by July 3.

Questions for approval:
- Is 500 within our marketing promo pool?
- Do we prefer issuing a time-limited trial (90 days) or a smaller credit that encourages activation (e.g., $50 credit / account)?
- Any per-account usage caps to limit abuse (recommendation: max 5 credits per account)?

I attached our distribution_template.csv (simple columns: code, expires_at, max_uses, notes) — if we get sign-off I'll generate the codes and the upload CSV.

Next steps I propose:
1) Marissa OKs allocation and policy (trial length and cap)
2) I generate codes, attach CSV, and send to Lena + Eventbrite for upload
3) Ben to confirm tagging in HubSpot for partner-sourced leads (please add company token DEVNIGHT25)

Can we close this today? They need the file by EOD July 3.

—Grace
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference

--- Message 3/4 (approval / policy) ---
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 13:20:05 -0700
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: 500 partner access codes for Dev Night (July 10)

Thanks Grace — good opportunity. Approved with these conditions:

- Allocate 500 promo codes from the Q3 partner budget (marketing credit).
- Issue as a 90-day trial window but with a per-account cap of 5 redemptions to prevent bulk account creation.
- Each code should map to a HubSpot campaign tag: DEVNIGHT25 (Ben, can you make sure lead source is set when they redeem?).
- Add an internal note column in the CSV with the partner name and event date.

Operational asks:
- Grace: please generate the batch and include the distribution_template.csv header.
- Ben: once codes are active, please create the HubSpot campaign and share the campaign ID link here.
- Neha: confirm we include a short paragraph in the attendee email encouraging account creation (we should display the $ equivalent in the email).

If no objections, Grace go ahead and send the CSV to Lena and cc Eventbrite so they can ingest it.

-Marissa
VP, Growth Marketing | Redwood Inference

--- Message 4/4 (fulfillment) ---
Date: Wed, 02 Jul 2025 15:45:12 -0700
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@devcommunity.org>, hackclub@devcommunity.org
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com, support@eventbrite.com
Subject: Re: Partner request: bulk access codes for Dev Night (500) 

Hi Lena —

Thanks — we're all set. Attached is the CSV with 500 unique codes (promo_codes_DEVNIGHT_500.csv) and a short fulfillment guide (fulfillment_instructions.pdf) with column descriptions and the recommended per-code settings. Summary:

- Trial window: 90 days from redemption (not issuance)
- Per-account cap: 5 redemptions max
- HubSpot campaign tag: DEVNIGHT25 (Ben will share the campaign ID in a follow-up)

Small sample of the CSV (first three rows):
code,expires_at,max_uses,notes
DEVN-7X9A-0H2Q,2025-10-15,1,Dev Night 7/10/25 - partner distro
DEVN-1Q2W-8M4E,2025-10-15,1,Dev Night 7/10/25 - partner distro
DEVN-4R6T-5Y8U,2025-10-15,1,Dev Night 7/10/25 - partner distro

Lena — when you upload, Eventbrite usually requires a CSV with a single "code" column; we included that as column 1 and kept notes for your reference. If you want, we can also provide a plain text list of codes.

Ben — can you confirm the HubSpot campaign ID and confirm tagging will run automatically when codes are redeemed?

If anything else is needed before July 3, ping me. Otherwise, best of luck at Dev Night — excited to see how many attendees redeem and convert.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachments: promo_codes_DEVNIGHT_500.csv (CSV, 500 rows), fulfillment_instructions.pdf (PDF, 2 pages), distribution_template.csv (CSV template)
